question.text: Which of the following strategies can help manage the risk of retirement goals being underfunded?

answer.text: Avoiding all market-linked investments to prevent losses
Periodic monitoring and updating of the retirement plan
Keeping all savings in cash to maintain liquidity
Postponing retirement planning until the pre-retirement stage

explanation.text: The Logic: Periodic review and monitoring allow the adviser and the client to adjust contributions, investment choices, savings levels, and plan assumptions before a shortfall becomes irreversible. This is the workbook's risk-control strategy for underfunding. The Trap: Avoiding market-linked investments altogether limits long-term returns and increases underfunding risk. Holding all savings as cash erodes real value through inflation. Postponing planning compresses the time available to accumulate the corpus. Note: Schedule formal reviews with the client at defined intervals to reassess corpus targets, performance, and any life changes that affect the plan.
